FINDING (high, correctness): `collect_state()` does not actually derive the real `doctor --agent` onboarding state. Evidence: [operations_guidance.py](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/operations_guidance.py:1358) calls only `config.doctor_registry.run_all_checks()`, while the CLI `dontpanic doctor --agent` path runs `check_agent_onboarding()` with CLI, manifest, executor, commands, global roles, and config-home checks in [dontpanic_doctor.py](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py:951) and is wired at [dontpanic_doctor.py](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py:2643). Recommendation: derive this state from the same `check_agent_onboarding()` surface, or a shared helper with equivalent results, instead of the unrelated registry-only checks.

FINDING (medium, correctness): Registered projects with missing `AGENTS.md` or no managed onboarding block still produce no setup guidance. Evidence: [operations_guidance.py](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/operations_guidance.py:1407) returns `(False, False)` when `AGENTS.md` is absent or the managed block is absent, while `doctor --project` explicitly reports those as onboarding WARN states with an exact re-onboard remediation in [dontpanic_doctor.py](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_doctor
